create_regnet_architecture: create a RegNet model architecture dict from block type, depth, width, and group parameters
create_regnetx_architecture: create a RegNet-X architecture using ir_k3 blocks with specified depth, width, and group ratios
create_regnety_architecture: create a RegNet-Y architecture using ir_k3_se blocks with squeeze-and-excitation and specified parameters
register_regnetz_models: register the RegNet_IB_700M model architecture with swish activation and ir_k3_se blocks into MODEL_ARCH
register_regnetx_models: register all twelve RegNet-X model architectures from 200M to 32G into the MODEL_ARCH registry
